item.title: Raised pavement causing exit difficulties, 17th November
item.description:
Outside number 54 All Saints Road. The camber of the pavement has become steep, which means that exiting the premises causes cars to scrape on the pavement and causes a potential safety issue accessing/entering the driveway, which is directly opposite a children's nursery. This has been reported before and has not been addressed, so I would be very grateful if it can be inspected as soon as possible. All it needs if to be relaid to shallow the camber of the pavement.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 50;52, All Saints' Road, Ewens Farm, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
